title.zh: 信号穿过真空的时候，到底是什么在传
title.en: What Is Actually Travelling When a Signal Crosses Empty Space

desc.zh: 旅行者 1 号离我们一光日，中间什么都没有，信号还是到了。这篇从电场和磁场讲起：麦克斯韦的四条定律怎么让波自己跑起来，光速从哪两个常数里算出来，波怎么被甩出来、带着什么、遇到物质和大气会怎样，再到调制、链路预算、光纤、衍射极限和相控阵，最后是 2026 年的前沿。十四个可以动手的模型，每个都是真方程的缩小版。
desc.en: Voyager 1 is one light-day away with nothing in between, and its signal still arrives. This essay starts from electric and magnetic fields: how Maxwell's four laws make a wave that carries itself, how the speed of light falls out of two bench-top constants, how waves are radiated, what they carry, and what matter and the atmosphere do to them; then modulation, link budgets, optical fibre, the diffraction limit and phased arrays, and the frontier as of 2026. Fourteen hands-on models, each the real equation at small scale.

title.zh: 场是真实的东西：ε₀ 与 μ₀
title.en: Fields are real: ε₀ and μ₀

desc.zh: 电荷先改变周围的空间，另一个电荷感受到的是所在位置的场；真空的两个常数 ε₀ 和 μ₀ 决定场有多容易建立。
desc.en: A charge changes the space around it and another charge feels the field where it sits; the vacuum constants ε₀ and μ₀ set how easily fields are made.

title.zh: 麦克斯韦方程组（积分形式）
title.en: Maxwell's equations in integral form

desc.zh: 四条定律：电场的高斯定律、磁场的高斯定律、法拉第定律、安培–麦克斯韦定律，每一项用话说清楚。
desc.en: The four laws (Gauss for E, Gauss for B, Faraday, Ampère–Maxwell) with every term said in words.

zh: 麦克斯韦方程是什么意思

title.zh: 位移电流
title.en: Displacement current

desc.zh: 变化的电场也产生磁场：充电的电容器极板之间没有电荷流过，却有 ε₀·dΦE/dt 这一项接着“电流”。
desc.en: A changing electric field also makes a magnetic field: between the plates of a charging capacitor no charge flows, yet ε₀·dΦE/dt carries the current on.

en: is there current between capacitor plates
changing electric field makes magnetic field

title.zh: 电磁波的波动方程与光速
title.en: The electromagnetic wave equation and the speed of light

desc.zh: 法拉第定律和安培–麦克斯韦定律合起来是波动方程，波速 1/√(μ₀ε₀) 正好是光速。
desc.en: Faraday's law and the Ampère–Maxwell law combine into a wave equation whose speed, 1/√(μ₀ε₀), is the speed of light.

zh: 光为什么能在真空里传播
en: how does light travel through a vacuum
why is the speed of light c

title.zh: 时域有限差分法（FDTD）与库朗条件
title.en: FDTD on a Yee grid and the Courant condition

desc.zh: 把 E 和 B 错开半格、半步轮流更新来模拟电磁波；每步不能走超过一格，否则数值发散。
desc.en: Simulating electromagnetic waves by leapfrogging E and B staggered by half a cell and half a step; a wave may not cross more than one cell per step or the numbers blow up.

title.zh: 折射率与菲涅耳反射
title.en: Refractive index and Fresnel reflection

desc.zh: 材料里波速是 c/n；垂直入射时界面反射的能量比例是 ((n₁−n₂)/(n₁+n₂))²，玻璃约 4%。
desc.en: In a material the wave travels at c/n; at normal incidence an interface reflects ((n₁−n₂)/(n₁+n₂))² of the energy, about 4% for glass.

zh: 光在玻璃里为什么变慢
en: why does light slow down in glass

title.zh: 加速电荷的辐射：拉莫尔公式与 sin²θ
title.en: Radiation from an accelerating charge: Larmor's formula and sin²θ

desc.zh: 只有加速的电荷才辐射，功率正比于加速度的平方，沿加速方向没有辐射。
desc.en: Only an accelerating charge radiates; the power goes as acceleration squared and there is none along the direction of acceleration.

zh: 为什么加速电荷会辐射

title.zh: 半波偶极子天线：方向图、方向性与辐射电阻
title.en: The half-wave dipole: pattern, directivity and radiation resistance

desc.zh: 长度为半个波长的直天线，方向性 1.64（2.15 dBi），辐射电阻约 73 欧；天线尺寸跟着波长走。
desc.en: A straight antenna half a wavelength long has directivity 1.64 (2.15 dBi) and a radiation resistance of about 73 Ω; antenna size follows wavelength.

title.zh: 坡印廷矢量、平方反比律与辐射压
title.en: Poynting vector, inverse-square law and radiation pressure

desc.zh: 电磁波每平方米每秒带走 E×B/μ₀ 的能量，强度按距离平方变弱，照到表面上有 I/c 的压强。
desc.en: An electromagnetic wave carries E×B/μ₀ per square metre per second, weakens as distance squared, and presses on a surface with I/c.

title.zh: 偏振与马吕斯定律
title.en: Polarisation and Malus's law

desc.zh: 偏振片把电场投影到自己的方向上，强度按 cos²θ 变化；在两片垂直的偏振片中间插一片，光反而能通过。
desc.en: A polariser projects the electric field onto its axis and intensity goes as cos²θ; a third sheet between two crossed ones lets light through.

zh: 偏光镜为什么能挡反光

title.zh: 电磁波谱与光子能量
title.en: The electromagnetic spectrum and photon energy

desc.zh: 从无线电到伽马射线是同一种波，只差频率；λ = c/f，E = hf；约 10 电子伏以上才是电离辐射。
desc.en: Radio to gamma rays are one kind of wave differing only in frequency; λ = c/f, E = hf; above about 10 eV the radiation is ionising.

zh: 无线电和光有什么区别
X 光和微波有什么不同
en: difference between radio waves and light

title.zh: 微波炉与水的介电弛豫
title.en: Microwave ovens and the dielectric relaxation of water

desc.zh: 2.45 吉赫不是水的共振频率；水的吸收是一个很宽的德拜弛豫带，峰值在约 19 吉赫，选 2.45 是为了穿透深度。
desc.en: 2.45 GHz is not a resonance of water; water absorbs over a broad Debye relaxation band peaking near 19 GHz, and 2.45 GHz is chosen for penetration depth.

zh: 微波炉是水分子共振吗
微波炉加热的食物有辐射吗
en: how does a microwave oven work

title.zh: 手机辐射：限值和各机构的结论
title.en: Phone radiation: the limits and what the agencies conclude

desc.zh: 射频电磁波是非电离辐射，已确认的作用是加热；ICNIRP 与 FCC 的 SAR 限值，以及 IARC、WHO 委托综述的原话。
desc.en: Radio-frequency waves are non-ionising and their established effect is heating; the ICNIRP and FCC SAR limits, and what IARC and the WHO-commissioned review say.

title.zh: 大气窗口与毫米波吸收
title.en: Atmospheric windows and millimetre-wave absorption

desc.zh: 氧气在 60 吉赫、水汽在 22 和 183 吉赫等处强烈吸收，中间留下几扇窗；按 ITU-R P.676 逐线计算。
desc.en: Oxygen near 60 GHz and water vapour at 22 and 183 GHz absorb strongly, leaving windows between; computed line by line from ITU-R P.676.

zh: 卫星通信为什么用这些频段
en: why 60 GHz does not travel far

title.zh: 调制：AM、FM、QAM 与带宽
title.en: Modulation: AM, FM, QAM and bandwidth

desc.zh: 把信息放到载波上就要占频带：调幅占两倍信息频率，调频按卡森公式；QAM 同时改幅度和相位。
desc.en: Putting information on a carrier takes bandwidth: AM takes twice the message frequency, FM follows Carson's rule; QAM changes amplitude and phase together.

zh: 为什么频率越高网速越快
en: why higher frequency means faster data

title.zh: 弗里斯公式与链路预算
title.en: The Friis equation and link budgets

desc.zh: 接收功率 = 发射功率 × 两端天线增益 × (λ/4πd)²；用分贝逐项加减，Wi-Fi、手机、GPS 和旅行者 1 号各算一遍。
desc.en: Received power = transmitted power × both antenna gains × (λ/4πd)²; added up in decibels for Wi-Fi, a phone, GPS and Voyager 1.

zh: 旅行者号的信号怎么收到的
en: why signals get weaker with distance
how weak is the GPS signal

title.zh: 光纤：全反射、损耗与 1550 纳米
title.en: Optical fibre: total internal reflection, loss and 1550 nm

desc.zh: 光纤靠全反射把光关在纤芯里；瑞利散射随波长下降、红外吸收随波长上升，最低点在 1550 纳米附近，约 0.18 dB/km。
desc.en: A fibre traps light by total internal reflection; Rayleigh scattering falls and infrared absorption rises with wavelength, leaving a minimum near 1550 nm of about 0.18 dB/km.

title.zh: 衍射极限与瑞利判据 1.22 λ/D
title.en: The diffraction limit and the Rayleigh criterion 1.22 λ/D

desc.zh: 有限口径出来的波一定散开 λ/D 左右，所以望远镜、天线和光刻能分辨的最小角度是 1.22 λ/D。
desc.en: A wave leaving a finite aperture spreads by about λ/D, so a telescope, dish or lithography lens resolves no finer than 1.22 λ/D.

zh: 望远镜为什么越大越好
en: can Hubble see the lunar lander

title.zh: 相控阵与波束赋形
title.en: Phased arrays and beam steering

desc.zh: 给一排天线依次加相位差，波束就转向；间距超过半个波长会出现栅瓣。
desc.en: Stepping the phase along a row of antennas steers the beam; spacing wider than half a wavelength produces grating lobes.

zh: 大规模天线 Massive MIMO 原理
星链天线怎么对准卫星

title.zh: 电磁波技术的前沿（2026 年 11 月）
title.en: The frontier of electromagnetic-wave technology (November 2026)

desc.zh: 6G 频段与时间表、Wi-Fi 7、手机直连卫星、光纤与深空激光通信纪录、空芯光纤、太赫兹间隙、高数值孔径 EUV，按日期和来源列出。
desc.en: 6G bands and timeline, Wi-Fi 7, direct-to-cell satellites, fibre and deep-space laser records, hollow-core fibre, the terahertz gap and high-NA EUV, dated and sourced.

title.zh: 看一条无线或光链路时问的四件事
title.en: Four questions to ask of any wireless or optical link

desc.zh: 频率是多少、带宽是多少、链路预算平不平、口径是波长的多少倍。
desc.en: What frequency, what bandwidth, does the link budget close, and how many wavelengths across is the aperture.

zh: 怎么看无线通信的参数
en: how to read a wireless spec
how to judge a radio link
